criteria.statement: The operator guide documents one signer-first create or update, deploy, automatic internal DNS, route-attach, approval, and health-verification flow for Astillero and equivalent Bahia-managed HTTP services.
The guide provides validation-compatible dnsmasq and Cloudflare Tunnel configuration using placeholder SecretRef UUIDs and states that SIGHUP reload reconstructs the whole application.
A healthy deployed service in edge-01-production projects an A or CNAME record in sharegap.net through the DNS reconciler.
Route attachment to an existing deployed service produces a route-only intent whose signed desired-state hash includes the route and preserves the deployed artifact.
Route-only execution succeeds through the routing lifecycle, and routing failure reports compensated restoration without artifact convergence.
DNS override names representing the zone apex as either @ or the zone name resolve to the apex without a duplicated suffix.
The documented workflow forbids direct SQL, manual runtime or proxy edits, manual Cloudflare dashboard changes, and real credential material; the final URL uses HTTPS without a port.
